user.title: Stopfinder – Sign In
user.description:
Enter your Stopfinder (Transfinder) account credentials.

**Note:** This integration uses undocumented Transfinder mobile APIs that are not officially supported for third-party use and may change or break without notice.

data_description.user_agent: Optional custom User-Agent header. Leave as default unless directed otherwise.

preferences.title: Tracking Preferences
preferences.description: GPS is fetched only within the active tracking windows. Scheduled times are always visible. Bus devices are created automatically when the first school-day schedule is fetched.

data_description.poll_interval: How often to fetch GPS while a tracking window is active. Outside windows, the coordinator runs hourly to keep the schedule fresh.
data_description.minutes_before_home_pickup: Morning window opens this many minutes before the scheduled home pickup
data_description.minutes_after_school_dropoff: Morning window closes this many minutes after the scheduled school dropoff
data_description.minutes_before_school_pickup: Afternoon window opens this many minutes before the scheduled school pickup
data_description.minutes_after_home_dropoff: Afternoon window closes this many minutes after the scheduled home dropoff
data_description.halfday_hour: School pickup before this hour (24h) = Half Day. Default: 13 (1:00 PM)
data_description.early_hour: School pickup before this hour (24h) = Early Release. Default: 14 (2:00 PM). Must be greater than Half-Day threshold.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Stopfinder API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_thresholds: Early Release hour must be greater than the Half-Day hour.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Stopfinder account is already configured.
